quotes.text: The A-SCDT is a composition of agentic AI, digital twins, and model-based optimization and simulation.

Essentially, the A-SCDT is a living model of the supply chain. It connects, orchestrates, and synchronises suppliers, plants, warehouses, production lines, logistics routes, demand signals, disruption alerts, capacities, and constraints into a dynamic environment with real-time and adequately updated data.

A manager communicates with models using the Generative AI Interface, supported by LLM Role Agents (e.g. developed in the Google Agent Development Kit) specialising in network, production, sourcing, and logistics tasks.

quotes.text: Through orchestration of agents with adaptable logic of individual models, the competence of making decisions (e.g. placing orders in an inventory control system) can be delegated to algorithms.

ft_note: Incluido como conceptual: el objeto es el concepto de gemelo agéntico (A-SCDT) con arquitectura (Fig. 4) y casos Microsoft/Ford tomados de la literatura; sin experimento ni datos propios. Integración mixta: apoyo consultivo centrado en el planificador (4) pero prevé agentes operativos que ejecutan decisiones rutinarias (5). Técnica LLM/agente; ML/RL sólo complementarios (¿Hybrid?).
